priority_items.summary: WTPQ32 PGUM 160311 Advisory Number 7 (111 PM ChST; LM 03:12:05 GMT) issues a Typhoon Warning for Guam, Rota and adjacent waters and a Tropical Storm Warning for Tinian, Saipan and adjacent waters. Champi still a tropical storm at 50 mph at 11.4N 153.3E (100 PM ChST / 0300 UTC); movement west 265 at 24 mph; about 590 miles ESE of Guam. Typhoon Watch remains for Tinian and Saipan. Flood Watch remains. Forecast: likely typhoon by Saturday; close to or over Guam Sunday morning. Next intermediate 500 PM ChST; next scheduled 800 PM ChST. Parent advertised 200 PM / 04:00 UTC; actual drop 111 PM / 03:11 UTC. This-window JMA WTPQ50 RJTD 160300 (LM 03:50:26 GMT) upgrades Champi from TS to STS 50 kt at 10.6N 153.3E. This-window CMA WTPQ20 BABJ 160300 (LM 03:16:17 GMT) still TS 23 m/s at 11.5N 153.6E. Leftover JTWC NR 007 still 045 kt (WMO 160300; LM unchanged). Leftover HLS 152250 still Watch-only 45 mph (lags Warning). Leftover CAP Watch Update still 8:50 AM O.CON. This-window CAP Hydro Outlook sent 13:48 ChST / 03:48 UTC (FGMY70 PGUM 160348) restates Flood Watch replacement. TCV still none. This-window GHS JIC Release No. 1: JIC partially activated; COR 2 effective 1:00 p.m. ChST; JRM TCCOR 2 ~1 p.m.; JIC body still prints Typhoon Watch. TS class split on 29W is now OPEN (JMA STS vs leftover JTWC TS vs NWS still-TS-with-Warning vs CMA still-TS). Not Category now. Not landfall. Not FLASH.
